sql_templates.description: Get the latest market regime, FII/DII flows, and breadth data for the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_data AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows), 
selected_dates AS (SELECT trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows, latest_data WHERE trade_date BETWEEN latest_date - INTERVAL '4 days' AND latest_date) 
SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.flow_signal, r.regime, r.confidence, b.ad_signal, i.trend_signal 
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f 
JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date 
JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date 
JOIN market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' 
WHERE f.trade_date IN (SELECT trade_date FROM selected_dates);
